title: How to Choose a WordPress Theme
description: A practical framework for choosing a WordPress theme around content, editing workflow, performance, and long-term maintenance.
metaDescription: A practical KreativWP guide to choosing a WordPress theme for a durable, maintainable site.
intro: This is a clearly marked guide outline. It establishes the practical questions the full tested guide will answer before it is published as editorial advice.

sections.title: Start with the editing workflow
sections.body: Choose around the way your team creates pages, posts, patterns, and reusable site elements—not around a feature list alone.

sections.title: Separate essentials from extras
sections.body: List the site capabilities you genuinely need, then avoid adding a theme because it promises controls that will never be used.

sections.title: Test the complete stack
sections.body: A theme should be checked alongside the plugins, host, content, and devices that will make up the actual site.
